rate_proposal.source_revision: ECMA-340 fourth edition June2024: clauses7-12 andAnnexA; NFCIP1 only, not all NFC-A/B/F/V or NFCForum certification
rate_proposal.note: No universal424k NFC default. Selected NFCIP1/A/B106k, F212k and PN7160V26.48k proposals differ; exact carrier/divisor and named rounded rates, RF versus hostI2C/SPI, firmware and role qualify every path. NCI255byte packet limit does not bound application bytes.
